items.name: alert
items.description: Displays a message with an optional action.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.description: Asks the user to confirm or cancel a consequential action.

items.name: autocomplete
items.description: Suggests and filters values as a user types.

items.name: avatar
items.description: Displays an image or fallback for a person or entity.

items.name: badge
items.description: Labels a status, category, or count.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.description: Shows the current page within a hierarchy.

items.name: button
items.description: Triggers an action or navigates to another page.

items.name: calendar
items.description: Displays and selects dates in one or more calendar months.

items.name: checkbox
items.description: Lets a user select or clear an option.

items.name: checkbox-group
items.description: Coordinates selection across a group of checkboxes.

items.name: collapsible
items.description: Shows and hides a panel from a trigger.

items.name: combobox
items.description: Selects one or more values from a filterable collection.

items.name: command
items.description: Presents searchable commands in a panel or dialog.

items.name: context-menu
items.description: Opens a menu at the pointer position for contextual actions.

items.name: date-format
items.description: Formats COSS date-picker labels with stable ordinal dates.

items.name: dialog
items.description: Displays focused content in a modal or non-modal overlay.

items.name: drawer
items.description: Presents draggable overlay content from an edge of the viewport.

items.name: empty
items.description: Explains an empty state and its next actions.

items.name: field
items.description: Connects a form control with its label, help text, and errors.

items.name: fieldset
items.description: Groups related form fields under a shared legend.

items.name: form
items.description: Coordinates form submission and field errors.

items.name: frame
items.description: Frames related content with a header and footer.

items.name: group
items.description: Joins related controls into one visual group.

items.name: hugeicons-icon
items.description: Renders official Hugeicons data during SSR and client hydration.

items.name: input
items.description: Collects a single line of user input.

items.name: input-group
items.description: Combines an input or textarea with inline and block addons.

items.name: menu
items.description: Presents actions, links, and nested choices from a trigger.

items.name: meter
items.description: Shows a scalar measurement within a known range.

items.name: number-field
items.description: Collects and adjusts a locale-aware numeric value.

items.name: otp-field
items.description: Collects a one-time code across a group of input slots.

items.name: pagination
items.description: Provides links for moving through a paged collection.

items.name: popover
items.description: Displays interactive content beside a trigger or anchor.

items.name: preview-card
items.description: Previews linked content when its trigger is hovered or focused.

items.name: progress
items.description: Shows progress toward completing a task.

items.name: radio-group
items.description: Lets a user choose one option from a set.

items.name: scroll-area
items.description: Adds custom scrollbars to overflowing content.

items.name: segmented-control
items.description: Shares COSS segmented-control sizing and state styles across primitives.

items.name: select
items.description: Chooses a value from a popup list.

items.name: sheet
items.description: Displays overlay content from a chosen side of the viewport.

items.name: sidebar
items.description: Builds responsive application navigation with collapsible desktop and mobile modes.

items.name: skeleton
items.description: Reserves space while content is loading.

items.name: slider
items.description: Selects one or more values within a range.

items.name: spinner
items.description: Indicates that an operation is in progress.

items.name: switch
items.description: Turns a setting on or off.

items.name: table
items.description: Displays structured data in rows and columns.

items.name: tabs
items.description: Switches between related panels in the same region.

items.name: toast
items.description: Displays transient status and action feedback.

items.name: toggle
items.description: Switches a single control between pressed and unpressed states.

items.name: toggle-group
items.description: Groups related toggle controls with shared selection behavior.

items.name: toolbar
items.description: Groups controls with coordinated keyboard navigation.

items.name: tooltip
items.description: Shows a short description when a trigger is hovered or focused.
